## free-tier-llm-landscape
*   **What matters:** The availability, limits, and terms of free-tier access to large language models are constantly evolving, directly impacting systems that rely on them.
*   **Why it matters to this system:** Our autonomous agent system operates exclusively on free tiers. Any changes to rate limits, model availability, or terms of service at providers like Groq, Together, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, or Hugging Face could immediately disrupt our operations or require significant re-engineering.
*   **One thing worth verifying:** Proactively check the official documentation and community forums for each mentioned provider for any announced changes to their free-tier offerings, especially concerning usage limits or model deprecations.
